WITH CTL
AS (
	SELECT CASE 
			WHEN MAX(RBB_PREVIOUS_MONTH) = CAST('2025-10-30' AS DATE)
				THEN CAST('2025-10-30' AS DATE)
			ELSE MAX(RBB_PREVIOUS_MONTH)
			END AS LATEST_DATE
	FROM EDS.DATE_DIM
	WHERE RBB_PREVIOUS_MONTH <= CAST('2025-10-30' AS DATE)
	)
	,BASE
AS (
	SELECT ORGKEY
		,PART_TRAN_TYPE
		,SOURCE_APP_CODE_DERIVED
		,FORMAT(DEP_HTD_TRAN_DATE, 'MMMM yyyy') AS MONTH_END
		,1 AS TRAN_CNT
	FROM (
		SELECT ACID
			,ORGKEY
			,TRAN_ID
			,PART_TRAN_SRL_NUM
			,DEP_HTD_TRAN_DATE
			,PART_TRAN_TYPE
			,SOURCE_APP_CODE_DERIVED
			,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
				PARTITION BY ACID
				,TRAN_ID
				,PART_TRAN_SRL_NUM
				,DEP_HTD_TRAN_DATE ORDER BY DEP_HTD_FILE_NAME DESC
				) RN
		FROM EDS.DEP_HTD_CHTR_REPRINT
		WHERE BANK_ID = 'CBC01'
			AND DEL_FLG = 'N'
		) A
	CROSS JOIN CTL C
	WHERE RN = 1
		AND LEFT(ORGKEY, 1) = 'R'
		AND DEP_HTD_TRAN_DATE >= DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(DATEADD(MONTH, - 2, C.LATEST_DATE)), MONTH(DATEADD(MONTH, - 2, C.LATEST_DATE)), 1)
		AND DEP_HTD_TRAN_DATE <= C.LATEST_DATE
	)
--MONTHLY AS (
SELECT 
	ORGKEY
	,PART_TRAN_TYPE
	,SOURCE_APP_CODE_DERIVED
	,MONTH_END
	,SUM(TRAN_CNT) AS MONTH_TRAN_CNT
FROM BASE
GROUP BY ORGKEY
	,PART_TRAN_TYPE
	,SOURCE_APP_CODE_DERIVED
	,MONTH_END
